description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git repository behaviors, specifically focusing on disabling local paths in clone/fetch operations, handling repositories with dash-prefixed names, and path normalization checks.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the repository.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Sets up protocol tests for URLs.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
